newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Saudi Commercial Bank net profit rises to 340 million riyals in 1996.
- Egypt to offer oil projects worth $10.5 billion to the private sector, oil minister says.
- Tunisian pharmaceutical exports worth $100 million, study.
- Saudi's Sabayek will soon sign a 35 million riyal contract to sell its products to the Saudi Iron and Steel Company.
- Egyptian government denies any external pressure on its privatisation programme.
